WTG_HOOK="$HOME/.local/bin/wtg-hook-codex"; if [ -x "$WTG_HOOK" ]; then "$WTG_HOOK" pre-tool-use; else "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/wtg-hook-codex" pre-tool-use; fi
WTG_HOOK="$HOME/.local/bin/wtg-hook-codex"; if [ -x "$WTG_HOOK" ]; then "$WTG_HOOK" permission-request; else "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/wtg-hook-codex" permission-request; fi
WTG_HOOK="$HOME/.local/bin/wtg-hook-codex"; if [ -x "$WTG_HOOK" ]; then "$WTG_HOOK" post-tool-use; else "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/wtg-hook-codex" post-tool-use; fi
WTG_HOOK="$HOME/.local/bin/wtg-hook-codex"; if [ -x "$WTG_HOOK" ]; then "$WTG_HOOK" stop; else "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/wtg-hook-codex" stop; fi
